thread:
Tina Ramos: Initial customer report: after moving services into private colo, their app intermittently fails to reach our Private VPC API. Symptoms: lots of '407 Proxy Authentication Required' followed by client-side 'tls: handshake failure'. They attached curl output and say they use a PAC file.
Alex Chen: Can you ask for the exact curl they ran and whether the PAC selects a proxy chain or DIRECT for the hostname? Also request /etc/hosts and resolv.conf.
Customer: Repro commands they ran and pasted:
```
curl -v --proxy http://proxy.corp:3128 https://api.redwood.internal/v1/health
```
curl shows HTTP/1.1 407 Proxy Authentication Required and Proxy-Authenticate: NTLM. Subsequent app logs show tls handshake error.
Devon Park: Two likely roots: proxy returning NTLM challenge that client won't follow, or internal DNS returning a private VIP that routes via a TLS-inspecting egress which breaks cert pinning. Ask them for dig +short A and SRV, and output of 'systemd-resolve --status' or resolvectl.
Maria Lopez: Also request a short tcpdump of the CONNECT flow for one failed attempt. If proxy is stripping SNI or injecting certs you'll see a MITM pattern. Suggest quick bypass tests: 1) curl --noproxy "*" if host has egress, 2) curl --resolve api.redwood.internal:443:<PUBLIC_IP> to skip split-horizon DNS.
Tina Ramos: Asked customer to run:
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host proxy.corp and port 3128 -w /tmp/proxy_conn.pcap
dig +short api.redwood.internal A
dig +short SRV _redwood-api._tcp.api.redwood.internal
cat /etc/hosts
cat /etc/resolv.conf
```
Alex Chen: Also try openssl s_client -connect <public_ip>:443 -servername api.redwood.internal -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
Devon Park: If tcpdump shows 407 with NTLM, confirm whether their HTTP client supports NTLM auth or whether proxy requires domain credentials. For short-term unblock advise: add hostname to proxy bypass (no auth path), or configure proxy rule to allow unauthenticated CONNECT to our VIPs, or install proxy CA into client trust stores if inspection is required.
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-2026-985 and attached.
Tina Ramos: Customer returned dig: api.redwood.internal -> 10.20.6.4 (private VIP). PAC returns PROXY proxy.corp:3128 for that name. They cannot reach our public IP directly from that subnet. Leaving thread open until pcap & curl trace are uploaded. :hourglass:
